name: Lady Death
talentDescription: While moving, grants 4 stacks per second, or 8 stacks if sprinting, up to a maximum of 40 stacks. A stack is consumed with each round fired, granting +15% Weapon Damage. Deploying a Skill consumes 10 stacks and grants +15% Skill Damage. Kills grant +10% Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

name: Warlord
talentDescription: While firing, reduces Incoming Damage by 25%. When firing ceases, applies 60% of the reduced damage and grants +10% Skill Damage for 10 seconds.

name: Strawberry Milkshake
talentDescription: Hits inflict a debuff, dealing 2.40% Weapon Damage over 4.50 seconds, up to 50 stacks. Enemies dying with this debuff transfer all stacks to a nearby enemy within 12 meters.

name: Scorpio
talentDescription: Hitting an enemy inflicts Venom for 2.50 seconds, up to 7 stacks. The target receives a debuff increasing with Venom stacks: 1 - Inflicts Bleed for 10 seconds. 3 - Inflicts Confusion for 2 seconds. 6 - Inflicts Shock for 3 seconds. 7 - Deals additional damage equal to 10% of Damage Dealt for 10 seconds.
acquisition: Classified Ops Pass 1.3 (premium track, tier 5) in Season 1 Phase 3. Since then: the Dark Zone vendor (added in Season 2 Phase 1) and Exotic Sealed Caches (added in Season 2 Phase 2), which can grant exotics from previous seasons

name: The Bighorn
talentDescription: Headshots grant +3.3% Headshot Damage for 20 seconds, up to 50 stacks.
note: Talent name, values and Piercing damage are TikTokAndy's reading of his level 1, T1 copy in his September 16, 2026 video. Ubisoft's August 5, 2026 announcement says it fires full auto, or semi-automatic when you aim down sights. Its stat lines aren't verified yet.
acquisition: Season 2 Phase 1 Classified Ops Pass (free and premium track). Since Season 2 Phase 2, Exotic Sealed Caches can grant exotics from previous seasons.
